title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs on Matters Relating to the Implementation of the Rural Collective Economic Organizations Law of the People's Republic of China
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

Notice on Matters Concerning the Implementation of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Rural Collective Economic Organizations

Fa [2025] No. 26

Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; Departments (Bureaus, Commissions) of Agriculture and Rural Affairs (Agriculture and Animal Husbandry) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Agriculture and Rural Affairs Bureau of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

The Law of the People's Republic of China on Rural Collective Economic Organizations (hereinafter referred to as the "Rural Collective Economic Organizations Law") has been adopted at the Tenth Session of the Standing Committee of the Fourteenth National People's Congress and will come into force on May 1, 2025. In order to effectively implement the Rural Collective Economic Organizations Law, the following matters are hereby notified:

1. Raise Political Awareness and Deeply Understand the Great Significance of Promulgating and Implementing the Rural Collective Economic Organizations Law

General Secretary Xi Jinping has emphasized the need to consolidate and improve the basic rural management system and develop new forms of rural collective economy. The Third Plenary Session of the Twentieth Central Committee of the Communist Party of China proposed to establish an operating mechanism with clear property rights and reasonable distribution, granting farmers more adequate property rights and interests. The promulgation of the Rural Collective Economic Organizations Law is a major measure to lay a solid legal foundation for promoting the growth and expansion of the rural collective economy. It is of great significance for safeguarding the legitimate rights and interests of rural collective economic organizations and their members, regulating rural collective economic organizations and their operation and management, promoting high-quality development of the new rural collective economy, consolidating and improving the basic rural management system and the basic socialist economic system, advancing comprehensive rural revitalization, accelerating the building of a strong agricultural country, and promoting common prosperity.

People's courts and agriculture and rural affairs departments at all levels must adhere to Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as a guide, raise political awareness, adhere to a people-centered approach, accurately grasp the legislative spirit of the Rural Collective Economic Organizations Law, and fully understand the great significance of its promulgation and implementation. In work practice, they must follow the legislative intent, accurately apply the law, effectively administer according to law and adjudicate according to law, and ensure the organic unity of political effect, social effect, and legal effect.

2. Strengthen Legal Awareness, Earnestly Carry Out Study, Training, and Publicity of the Rural Collective Economic Organizations Law

People's courts and agriculture and rural affairs departments at all levels must earnestly shoulder their responsibilities, strengthen organizational leadership, and make studying the Rural Collective Economic Organizations Law and related laws and regulations an important task for the near future and beyond. In particular, they must make full use of the window period before the law comes into effect, and through self-study, collective study within the unit, case analysis, discussions and exchanges, centralized training, and other methods, carry out in-depth study and publicity, strengthening the historical thinking, dialectical thinking, and bottom-line thinking in law enforcement and judicial work. They are encouraged and supported to organize joint training, joint research, special lectures, and joint discussions among people's courts and agriculture and rural affairs departments at all levels, strengthen the popularization of legal knowledge within their jurisdictions targeting rural collective economic organizations, and create a strong atmosphere of studying, researching, abiding by, and applying the law.

3. Closely Coordinate and Collaborate to Effectively Ensure the Smooth and Effective Implementation of the Rural Collective Economic Organizations Law

People's courts and agriculture and rural affairs departments at all levels must comprehensively review and carefully evaluate the normative documents formulated and issued by their own units in light of the provisions of the Rural Collective Economic Organizations Law. Documents that do not comply with the law must be adjusted or abolished in a timely manner. If it is found that documents formulated by other units or departments in the locality fall into the above situation, opinions and suggestions must be promptly submitted to the relevant units or departments, and cooperation must be actively provided to resolve the issue, ensuring smooth policy implementation, promoting legal uniformity, and maintaining legal authority. They must conduct preliminary research and pre-judgment, accurately grasp the factors that may hinder the smooth implementation of the law in practice and the base number of related conflicts and disputes, strengthen the investigation of problems and shortcomings, actively summarize useful experience, plan ahead and make thorough arrangements, enrich and prepare the "toolkit", and form effective contingency plans. They must closely coordinate and collaborate, establish related joint meeting and linkage mechanisms, promptly communicate and study new situations and new problems, and jointly promote the resolution of major and difficult issues.

4. Give Full Play to Functions and Deeply Promote the Substantive Resolution of Conflicts and Disputes

We must uphold and develop the "Fengqiao Experience" in the new era, strive with the utmost dedication to realize the resolution of disputes and the cessation of litigation, give full play to the functions of law enforcement and justice, fulfill our responsibilities within our jurisdiction, avoid procedural formalism, and promote the substantive resolution of conflicts and disputes. Where a party disputes the confirmation of membership in a rural collective economic organization, or where a dispute arises within a rural collective economic organization due to internal management, operation, income distribution, etc., and the party applies to the agriculture and rural affairs department of the people's government at the county level for mediation and settlement, the agriculture and rural affairs department must fulfill its duties and actively resolve the conflict or dispute in a timely manner. Agriculture and rural affairs departments must promote the establishment and improvement of rural land contract arbitration institutions, guide and help rural land contract arbitration institutions to strengthen the professional training of arbitrators, improve the legal and policy level of arbitrators, and enhance the quality and efficiency of arbitration work. People's courts at all levels must attach great importance to and give full play to the important role of mediation and arbitration in resolving disputes, improve the linkage mechanism between people's mediation, industry mediation, administrative mediation and judicial mediation and litigation, and promote the enforcement of arbitration awards according to law. They must protect the parties' right of action according to law. After the Rural Collective Economic Organizations Law comes into effect, where a party brings a lawsuit in accordance with Article 56 of this Law, the people's court shall accept it according to law.

People's courts and agriculture and rural affairs departments at all levels must support township people's governments and sub-district offices in mediating disputes over the rights and interests of rural collective economic organizations and their members according to law, and support rural land contract arbitration institutions in mediating and arbitrating according to law. They must attach great importance to all types of deep-seated conflicts in the development of rural collective economic organizations, insist on placing non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms first, actively integrate into the social governance system of co-construction, co-governance, and sharing under the leadership of the Party committee, improve working mechanisms such as the connection between litigation and mediation, the connection between litigation and arbitration, and information sharing, and promote the resolution of disputes at the front line and their substantive resolution. Higher people's courts and provincial-level agriculture and rural affairs departments must strengthen guidance to lower levels, take appropriate measures to effectively address difficulties and problems at the grassroots level, and earnestly summarize and promote useful experiences.

5. Strengthen Organizational Leadership and Strive to Build a Strong Contingent for Agricultural, Rural, and Farmer Affairs

Each Higher People's Court and each provincial-level agriculture and rural affairs department must fully understand the great significance of implementing the Rural Collective Economic Organizations Law, strengthen organizational leadership, earnestly guide the units within their respective jurisdictions to pay more attention to system integration, and continuously optimize working mechanisms. People's courts at all levels must coordinate the creation and demonstration of "Fengqiao-style People's Courts" and the upgrading of one-stop litigation service centers, give full play to the overall effectiveness of dispute resolution, and effectively achieve the resolution of cases and the satisfaction of all parties, ensuring smooth governance and social harmony.

People's courts and agriculture and rural affairs departments at all levels must equip and strengthen teams handling disputes involving rural collective economic organizations, providing strong talent support for the proper resolution of disputes. Intermediate and grassroots people's courts and county-level agriculture and rural affairs departments must assign judicial and administrative personnel with strong legal application ability, policy understanding ability, communication and coordination ability, and mass work ability to frontline positions, ensuring that the "people around the masses" are also the "intimate confidants of the masses" and "capable persons" for explaining legal principles and resolving disputes, thereby building a strong contingent that safeguards the vigorous and healthy development of agricultural, rural, and farmer affairs.

Experiences, practices, difficulties, and problems encountered during the implementation of the Rural Collective Economic Organizations Law in various localities shall be reported promptly level by level to the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs.

February 25, 2025
